title: Parts added to a paid work order that is reopened
stem: When a paid work order is reopened by adding a line, which tier prices the parts added to it?

options.t: The customer's tier as it is now, as the developers built it
options.why: the new parts are new work done after payment, the same way a split work order takes the customer's current tier

options.t: The tier the work order was made with, as the PRD's general rule would say

context: The PRD says a work order keeps the tier its customer had when it was made; moving a customer to another tier affects only work orders made afterwards or by splitting. No sentence covers reopening. The developers built the reopened work order to take the customer's current tier and told Product as an FYI. It decides the price on a real invoice for any customer whose tier changed since the job was opened.
where: PRD Story 10 (which tier a work order keeps); developers' plan for Tiered Pricing (11 Nov 2026), clarifications and Phase 4; ticket SV-12667 item 1
